adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` now performs an unconditional refresh-token request via `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and updates Prisma on every call through that path, with no expiry/need check and no request timeout shown. It also does not use the newly added `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (used elsewhere in this PR) and instead directly calls the Salesforce token endpoint, so credential-sync routing (via `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`) is bypassed for Salesforce. While this is a concrete, diff-grounded performance/architecture concern and could contribute to rate limiting, the diff alone can’t prove how often the service is constructed/called in production, so it’s better classified as an important issue rather than a definite functional defect.
